decision.rationale: TXN-007982 is a recurring charge of 52.90 EUR from Ashgrove Athletic Club (MER-000063) on card CRD-000223. The charge was made on 2026-10-11 and posted on 2026-10-12. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, 10 days after posting, which is well within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant issued a written cancellation confirmation (DOC-000038) saying the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-10-05. The cancellation took effect six days before the charge, so the charge should not have been made under recurring-cancelled-before-charge. The credit is the disputed charge only: 52.90 EUR, which matches the claimed amount and is far below the 3,000.00 EUR provisional credit limit. Neither the cardholder's statement nor the document contained any instruction to the bank.
